title: The Drop Trait
summary: Custom logic executed automatically when a value goes out of scope.
lecture: When a value goes out of scope in Rust, its destructor runs automatically to release resources such as heap memory, file descriptors, or locks.
You can implement the `Drop` trait for custom types to specify cleanup actions in its `drop` method.
Rust guarantees that `drop` is called exactly once when the value falls out of scope, preventing resource leaks without needing a garbage collector.

example.caption: Custom drop logic runs when Secret goes out of scope.
